issues.description: `sys` is referenced in both mathimpl.py files without an `import sys`, risking NameError at module load.
issues.detail: The diff adds `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11):` guards in numba/cpython/mathimpl.py and numba/np/math/mathimpl.py but shows no corresponding `import sys`. If sys is not already imported at module top, these modules will fail at import on every Python version. Verify and add the import where missing.

issues.description: Conditional `Math_unary` registration is placed at module scope with ambiguous block boundary in mathdecl.py.
issues.detail: The `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11): Math_unary = infer_global(math.exp2)(Math_unary)` is dedented out of the class body with no clear separating blank line and rebinds the class as a side effect. The postcondition of applying `infer_global` to the same template twice is not stated. Move to a clearly delimited top-level block with a comment, or use a data-driven registry.

issues.description: Version-gating uses two inconsistent idioms: `sys.version_info` in sources, `PYVERSION` in tests.
issues.detail: The codebase already exposes `numba.core.utils.PYVERSION`, which the test imports. Production modules use raw `sys.version_info` instead, creating two sources of truth for the same predicate across three files. Unify on `PYVERSION` so the version policy lives in one place.

issues.description: Test reuses `exp` x_values verbatim and does not exercise inputs where exp2 semantics matter.
issues.detail: Inputs were cloned from `test_exp` and never probe exp2's interesting behavior: exact results at integer powers, overflow near ~1024, large negatives, or denormals. Add at least one integer power, one near-overflow, and one large-negative input to validate the LLVM intrinsic matches CPython semantics.

issues.description: Release note file `10276.new_feature.rst` is missing a terminating newline.
issues.detail: The diff explicitly notes `\ No newline at end of file`. POSIX text files should end with a newline and many doc toolchains and linters complain. Trivial hygiene fix.

issues.description: The fact "math.exp2 exists from Python 3.11" is duplicated as imperative gates in three files.
issues.detail: A single piece of data (function name, intrinsic, minimum Python version) is encoded as parallel `if` branches across mathdecl, cpython/mathimpl, and np/math/mathimpl. A small registry mapping (name, min_version) to intrinsic would decompose the version policy into data, making future additions trivial.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on a small patch that delegates `math.exp2` to `llvm.exp2` but ships with two likely import-time defects: missing `import sys` in two impl files and a dedented conditional that rebinds `Math_unary` outside its class body with unstated semantics. Version-gating diverges across files (`sys.version_info` vs the project's existing `PYVERSION`), and the test was cloned from `test_exp` without probing inputs where exp2 semantics actually matter. Verdict: tested-not-proved. Fix the imports, unify on `PYVERSION` (ideally as a small registry), broaden the test inputs to exp2-specific values, and clean up the release-note hygiene before merging.
